text.en: Ainu was not traditionally a written language ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--ainu-was-not-traditionally-a-written-language⟧. In almost all previous descriptions of Ainu, references comparing similarities and differences with Japanese are widespread ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--in-almost-all-previous-descriptions-of-ainu-references⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語は伝統的に文字をもつ言語ではなかった⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--ainu-was-not-traditionally-a-written-language⟧。これまでのほぼすべてのアイヌ語の記述において、日本語との類似点や相違点への言及が多く見られる⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--in-almost-all-previous-descriptions-of-ainu-references⟧。

text.en: The oldest extant recorded source on the Ainu language is the vocabulary *Matsumae no koto - Ezo kotoba no koto* from around 1600, which contains 117 words and short phrases compiled for merchants trading with the Ainu ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-oldest-extant-recorded-source-on-the-ainu⟧. The earliest non-Japanese word list of Ainu was compiled in 1621 by Jeronymo de Angelis and contains 54 Ainu words, 36 of which are numerals ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-earliest-non-japanese-word-list-of-ainu⟧. The Japanese-Ainu dictionary *Ezo hōgen moshiogusa*, compiled in 1792 by Uehara Kumajirō and Abe Chōzaburō, contains nearly 3,000 words classified by meaning, alongside common phrases and short texts ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-japanese-ainu-dictionary-ezo-h-gen-moshiogusa⟧. A distinct Honshu Tohoku dialect is generally not established in Ainu dialectology because the surviving evidence is limited to place names and some personal names, with no records of everyday vocabulary made before speakers disappeared ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--a-distinct-honshu-tohoku-dialect-is-generally-not⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語に関する現存最古の記録資料は1600年頃の『松前のこと・蝦夷言葉のこと』であり、交易商人のために編纂された117の単語および短い語句を収録している⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-oldest-extant-recorded-source-on-the-ainu⟧。アイヌ語の非日本語による最古の語彙集は1621年にジェロニモ・デ・アンジェリスによって作成されたもので、54語のアイヌ語単語（うち36語は数詞）を収録している⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-earliest-non-japanese-word-list-of-ainu⟧。1792年に上原熊次郎と阿部澂三郎によって編纂された和アイヌ語辞書『蝦夷方言藻汐草』は、意味別に分類された約3,000語に加え、日常表現のリストや短いテキストを収録している⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-japanese-ainu-dictionary-ezo-h-gen-moshiogusa⟧。アイヌ語の方言区分において本州東北方言という区分が通常設けられないのは、資料が地名と若干の人名に限られ、日常語の記録が全くなされないうちに話者がいなくなってしまったからである⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--a-distinct-honshu-tohoku-dialect-is-generally-not⟧。

text.en: The 18th- and 19th-century Russian and Polish word lists compiled by Krasheninnikov, Steller, and Dybowski primarily contain vocabulary from Northern Kuril Ainu ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-18th-and-19th-century-russian-and-polish⟧. Dobrotworski's *Ainsko-Russkij Slovar* (1875) contains 10,930 entries, about half of which were collected in Sakhalin ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--dobrotworski-s-ainsko-russkij-slovar-1875-contains-10⟧. Bronisław Piłsudski published a collection of Sakhalin Ainu texts with translations in 1912 under the title *Materials for the Study of Ainu Language and Folklore* ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--bronis-aw-pi-sudski-published-a-collection-of⟧. Batchelor (1938) lists *i-* as a third-person singular object form ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--batchelor-1938-lists-i-as-a-third-person⟧. Until Kubodera's dictionary draft was published in 1991, Batchelor's dictionary was the only alphabetical Ainu-Japanese dictionary even for the most extensively described Saru dialect ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--until-kubodera-s-dictionary-draft-was-published-in⟧. Despite researchers frequently visiting Shiraoi from early on, linguistic documentation of the Shiraoi dialect remains considerably limited ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--despite-researchers-frequently-visiting-shiraoi-from-early-on⟧.
text.ja: クラシェニンニコフ、ステラー、ディボフスキらによる18・19世紀のロシアおよびポーランドの語彙集は、主に北千島アイヌ語の語彙を収録している⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-18th-and-19th-century-russian-and-polish⟧。ドブロトヴォルスキーの『アイヌ・ロシア語辞典』（1875年）は10,930の見出し語を収録しており、その約半数はサハリン現地で収集されたものである⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--dobrotworski-s-ainsko-russkij-slovar-1875-contains-10⟧。ブロニスワフ・ピウスツキは1912年に『アイヌ語および民俗学研究資料』と題して、翻訳付きの樺太アイヌ語テキストを出版した⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--bronis-aw-pi-sudski-published-a-collection-of⟧。Batchelor（1938）は*i-*を三人称単数目的語形式として挙げている⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--batchelor-1938-lists-i-as-a-third-person⟧。最も記述の進んでいる沙流方言でさえ、1991年に久保寺逸彦の辞典稿が出るまでは、通常の音引き形式の辞書はバチェラーの辞書しか存在しなかった⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--until-kubodera-s-dictionary-draft-was-published-in⟧。白老は早くから多くの研究者が訪れていたにもかかわらず、方言の言語的記録はそれに比べてかなり限られている⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--despite-researchers-frequently-visiting-shiraoi-from-early-on⟧。

text.en: Chiri (1942) was the first to propose the now-established analyses that Ainu has no need to set up an adjective word class distinct from verbs and that property-concept/stative verbs also incorporate change into that state as part of their meaning ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--chiri-1942-was-the-first-to-propose-the⟧. Connected verbs were previously referred to as 'type-3 verbs' by Kindaichi and Chiri, 'separable verbs' by Sato (2008a), and 'connected transitive verbs' in the Saru dialect dictionary ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--connected-verbs-were-previously-referred-to-as-type⟧. Chiri Mashio considered that all polysyllabic words in Ainu may be split up into mono- or bisyllabic morphemes or single phonemes carrying separate meanings ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--chiri-mashio-considered-that-all-polysyllabic-words-in⟧. The first comparative study of Ainu dialects was a 1960 lexico-statistical survey of nineteen dialects conducted by Shiro Hattori and Mashio Chiri using the Swadesh 200-word list ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-first-comparative-study-of-ainu-dialects-was⟧.
text.ja: 知里（1942）は、アイヌ語では形容詞を動詞と区別して立てる必要がないことや、性質・状態を表す動詞がその状態への変化の意味も併せ持つことなど、現在定説となっている見解を初めて示した⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--chiri-1942-was-the-first-to-propose-the⟧。連動詞は、古くは金田一・知里により「第三類の動詞」、佐藤（2008a）では「分離動詞」、沙流方言辞典では「連他動詞」と呼ばれている⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--connected-verbs-were-previously-referred-to-as-type⟧。知里真志保は、アイヌ語のすべての多音節語は、独自の意味を担う単音節・2音節の形態素あるいは単一の音素にさえ分割できるという見解をとっていた⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--chiri-mashio-considered-that-all-polysyllabic-words-in⟧。アイヌ語方言に関する最初の比較研究は、服部四郎と知里真志保によってスワデシュの200基礎語彙リストに基づいて行われた19方言の語彙統計学的調査（1960年）であった⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--the-first-comparative-study-of-ainu-dialects-was⟧。

text.en: Linguistic descriptive research on the Chitose dialect of Ainu began in the 1980s, eventually producing grammars and dictionaries second only to those of the Saru dialect ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--linguistic-descriptive-research-on-the-chitose-dialect-of⟧. Tamura interprets both *a* and *nisa* as tense markers in the Saru dialect ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--tamura-interprets-both-a-and-nisa-as-tense⟧. In Refsing's analysis of the Shizunai dialect, *siri* is interpreted as a nominalizer rather than as a marker of visual perception mood ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--in-refsing-s-analysis-siri-is-interpreted-as⟧, and *hawe* is defined as a nominalizer rather than an auditive perception mood marker ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--in-refsing-s-analysis-hawe-is-defined-as⟧. A construction involving the case postposition *ta* and the existential verb *oka* expressing subjunctive or desiderative meaning is not found in the Shizunai dialect material ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--a-construction-involving-the-case-postposition-ta-and⟧. Murasaki (1967) classifies Ainu verbs into intransitive (V0), transitive (V1), and ditransitive (V2) ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--murasaki-1967-classifies-ainu-verbs-into-intransitive-v0⟧, and accounts for the inflection of Ainu verbs and nouns by transformational rules of deletion, replacement, and movement ⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--murasaki-1967-accounts-for-the-inflection-of-ainu⟧.
text.ja: 千歳方言の言語学的な記述研究は1980年代に入ってから始まり、沙流方言に次ぐほどの文法書や辞書が作成されるに至った⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--linguistic-descriptive-research-on-the-chitose-dialect-of⟧。田村は沙流方言において*a*と*nisa*の双方を時制標識と解釈している⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--tamura-interprets-both-a-and-nisa-as-tense⟧。レフシングの静内方言の分析において、*siri*は見説法の標識ではなく名詞化辞として解釈され⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--in-refsing-s-analysis-siri-is-interpreted-as⟧、*hawe*は聞説法の標識ではなく名詞化辞として定義される⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--in-refsing-s-analysis-hawe-is-defined-as⟧。格後置詞*ta*と存在動詞*oka*を用いた願望・接続法構文は、静内方言の資料には見られない⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--a-construction-involving-the-case-postposition-ta-and⟧。村崎（1967）はアイヌ語の動詞を自動詞（V0）、他動詞（V1）、および複他動詞（V2）に分類し⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--murasaki-1967-classifies-ainu-verbs-into-intransitive-v0⟧、要素の削除・置換・移動に基づく変形規則によって動詞と名詞の語形変化を処理している⟦claim:sources/history-of-description-research--murasaki-1967-accounts-for-the-inflection-of-ainu⟧。
